decisions.reason: As a somewhat peripheral but still ergonomically relevant office product with another year to learn from and a large firm's remaining slack, it stays for now though it remains under closer scrutiny than core system lines.

This luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core interior-lighting business and the platform-style continuity suggests performance is likely above aspiration, so resources are better used to support it than to exit it.

After pruning other marine lines, this searchlight looks like the stronger surviving specialist offer and is still close enough to the firm's robust-application capabilities to retain while management evaluates whether it meets niche-market aspirations.
